outcome_detail: Suit filed in March 2026 against Inspector Jeremy Scheublin; it was newly pending as of July 2026 coverage of his criminal arraignment. No resolution reported.
criminal_detail: Inspector Jeremy Scheublin was indicted by a Bronx grand jury and arraigned on July 10, 2026 on charges including attempted rape, sexual abuse, assault, unlawful imprisonment, forcible touching, official misconduct, and obstructing governmental administration, stemming from the alleged January 2025 assault on a female subordinate in his 46th Precinct office. He pleaded not guilty; bail was set at $75,000 bond or $25,000 cash, with a next court date of October 30, 2026.
description: A female NYPD officer assigned to the 46th Precinct in the Bronx filed a lawsuit in March 2026 against Inspector Jeremy Scheublin, the precinct's former commanding officer, alleging sexual harassment and retaliation. According to the complaint, Scheublin subjected her to a pattern of unwanted advances and inappropriate comments beginning after his December 2023 arrival at the precinct, culminating in a January 1, 2025 encounter in his office in which he allegedly grabbed her, threw her onto a couch, tried to kiss her, and attempted to remove her gun belt before she fought him off. The suit also alleges he later threatened her, saying that things had not gone well for the last person who made accusations against him. In July 2026, Bronx prosecutors announced Scheublin's indictment on attempted rape and related charges over the alleged assault; he pleaded not guilty. The civil case remains pending.
